basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I enjoy exploring the latest gadgets and gaming setups. I have a soft spot for discussing tech products and troubleshooting hardware issues. In my downtime, you might find me catching up on the latest gaming streams or engaging in lively discussions about hardware performance. I usually browse Reddit after work hours, typically from 7 PM to midnight. I’m currently single and enjoy the flexibility that comes with it, allowing me to dive deep into my tech hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 8 years. My expertise primarily lies in software development, but I've cultivated a solid understanding of hardware through personal projects and building custom PCs. I often stay updated by reading tech blogs and participating in online forums.
